about_the_game:
Digital Defender O.R.C. is a blended tower defense and tactical RPG where you protect monsters from harm. Use an arsenal of obstacles, traps, and digital combatants to fend off digital assassins and defend the innocent.

DEPLOY UNITS

A variety of different monsters are willing to project digital avatars to help fight off the incoming assailants. Employ different monsters with different quirks, attack ranges, and elemental affinities to fend off incoming invaders. Slimes, dragons, skeletons, floating eyes, and many others can each lend their hand in their own way, acting as solutions for a variety of situations.

PLACE OBSTACLES

Force incoming foes to take a different route by blocking entry through doorways with firewalls, place data spikes to harm any who pass over them, delay the advance of opponents with a GOTO push, and more by placing obstacles along the path that the enemy will take.

OPERATE IN DIFFERENT PHASES

In the PREPARE PHASE you may place units and obstacles freely with what Bux you have, in preparation for the COMBAT PHASE.

In the COMBAT PHASE, enemies advance and attack on a turn-by turn basis, and between each turn you are afforded a single action while you generate more Bux each turn of inactivity.

Place a new unit, rally an existing unit for an extra attack, adjust the position of a unit, or even combat or pay off the enemy, and then the next round of combat happens. Choose your actions wisely!

PLAY MISSION MODE OR CAMPAIGN MODE

In MISSION MODE, you defend individual monsters from harm as their gallant defender. Each mission is an individualized and consistent challenge for you to overcome.

Or, take the fight to the doorstep of your foes in CAMPAIGN MODE, protecting your envoy and building your power as you advance towards the ever-changing heart of the enemy to stop their onslaught in a rogue-like sequence of levels that is never quite the same!

short_description: In the dark cyber future of 200X, monsterkind needs YOUR help! As the Overseer of Retaliatory Combat (O.R.C. for short), you must protect monsters from digital assassins! Coordinate monster units and place obstacles & traps to stop the slaughter of the innocent in this tactical tower defense game.
